_purpose: Scenario 2/4 of T023 (spec Edge Case "empty state", contract CT-008, data-model.md V-CR-3). A window with ZERO eligible closure events. cycle_report.py MUST emit the honest empty-window state -- NEVER a zero-valued statistic, NEVER an average of nothing, NEVER exit non-zero (an empty window is not a failure).
_rationale: 2020-01-01..2020-01-02 predates every commit in this repository's history (this repository's git history and the tracker DB's earliest rows are both from a much later date -- a 1-day window in 2020 is guaranteed to contain zero closure events without depending on any mutable 'today' state).
